brief:
Israeli soldiers who served in Gaza have given testimony about their conduct during military operations, prompting a strong reaction across much of the country's political establishment, Al Jazeera English reported. The allegations have reignited debate within Israel over soldier accountability and the conduct of operations in Gaza.

The testimony has divided Israeli political figures, with some defending the soldiers' actions while others have called for investigations into the allegations. The controversy reflects ongoing tensions within Israeli society over military conduct and the broader conflict.
dek: Israeli soldiers' Gaza testimony causes backlash across much of the country's political establishment.
title: Israeli soldiers' Gaza testimony sparks political backlash
